limits: 97 is the number of page source files, including redirects, dynamic templates and diagnostic pages; it is not a count of distinct URLs or all possible business states. 32 is the shared-control inventory. Final acceptance combines their recorded family reviews with shared-style verification and selected cross-screen tests.

The source of visual truth is pinned MIT Frappe Espresso e8d41dd0061a32ee781caefe5d0b0d2bb7c15362. The original CSS was rendered in a clearly labelled component probe, not in a running ERPNext instance. No whole-screen pixel-identity claim is made for different Bazaar and ERPNext modules.

Intentional differences: Bazaar blue and one brand mark; customer-confirmed operational columns; existing POS, print and merchant-brand workflows; mobile touch targets; permanent module dock behavior. Product document/navigation composition changes remain explicitly disclosed in redesign-change-audit.json and were checked through the recorded workflows; test success does not constitute human preference approval.

Selected RU/KG/EN, desktop/mobile and light/dark states were checked by family and for shared controls. This does not assert a Cartesian product of all routes, roles, stores, plans, themes, languages and states, or full editorial translation of pre-existing public API documentation, email-editor copy and technical provider identifiers.

No live AI/voice model-quality, real marketplace publication, acquiring, email delivery, physical printer, camera/USB scanner, native mobile or every-browser certification is claimed by this visual redesign. Their configured-provider/device acceptance is independent of the preserved UI and isolated domain regressions.

Historical family reports are point-in-time evidence. Old pending counts and initial role claims are superseded only where explicitly reconciled below. Local screenshot/log evidence stays in ignored artifacts; tracked reports link to it.
delivery: Implementation and bounded local acceptance complete on codex/playground; no main merge,push or deployment.
infrastructureNotes: Do not run the prebuild Prisma client generator concurrently with tests or a running server that loads the same generated library. One overlapping run passed its test assertions but failed with an unhandled partial-library load; the sequential rerun completed 254 files / 1854 tests without that error.
The browser fixture database was not reset; destructive integration checks used a separately created allowlisted local database, with external providers disabled.

Local PostgreSQL C locale was reproduced as the cause of two Cyrillic-search test failures. Both isolated QA databases were preserved into ICU und databases with all-table row-hash equality and retained backups; regression runner checks the Unicode contract. See warehouse checkpoint.

The first custom dev-server attempt shared root .next because Next 14 custom-server preparation reloads configuration and ignores the passed conf. It removed local QA production manifests and caused local 500s. Stopped the owned dev/production processes, moved dev into a disposable source+messages snapshot with the standard CLI and separate localhost cookie host, rebuilt production, then replayed final browser captures and scanner checks. Initial snapshot omission of messages was fixed before successful sign-in. Root Next/TypeScript configuration is unchanged. Final evidence: artifacts/ux/espresso/scanner-dev-isolation.json and build-admin-recovered-final.log.
